summary: Parse, navigate, validate, modify, and render Health Level Seven (HL7) messages in Rust. A Cargo workspace of fourteen small, mostly dependency-free crates: HL7 v2 (releases 2.1-2.9) with three parsing modes and a command-line tool, a foundation for HL7 v3, format conversion between ER7 (pipe-delimited), the official v2.xml, and JSON, transports (MLLP, SOAP), and tooling to build a vendor dictionary from a site's own XSDs.
